asked.item: How many of the 20 spots that is

verdict.reason: The help pages state that a LinkedIn profile and each company Page count as one account each, and they give the Starter limit of 20.

steps.text: Your LinkedIn profile and each company Page each count as one account, so your LinkedIn profile and 3 company Pages count as 4 accounts.
The Starter plan allows 20 connected social accounts, and those 4 accounts count toward that limit.
